# Ponytail attribution

The engineering guidance in `references/PONYTAIL_ENGINEERING.md` adapts ideas from [DietrichGebert/ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail), under the [MIT license](LICENSE).

Reviewed upstream revision: [`09c434ab73ca43761c5d8b0c5d341926c2fba710`](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/tree/09c434ab73ca43761c5d8b0c5d341926c2fba710), retrieved 2026-10-19. Its Codex plugin manifest reports version `5.3.2`.

Reviewed sources:

- [Core skill](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/blob/09c434ab73ca43761c5d8b0c5d341926c2fba710/skills/ponytail/SKILL.md)
- [Review skill](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/blob/09c434ab73ca43761c5d8b0c5d341926c2fba710/skills/ponytail-review/SKILL.md)
- [Plugin metadata](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/blob/09c434ab73ca43761c5d8b0c5d341926c2fba710/.codex-plugin/plugin.json)

The adaptation applies to Cinematic Web Director's approved implementation/review work. It preserves creative intent and scoped approvals, uses the project's existing reporting/test conventions and excludes upstream session persistence, automatic minimal-product assumptions, plugin hooks, mode commands and benchmark claims. Those upstream features are not provided by this integration.
